CS 124 (From Languages to Information, Spring 2021)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Trained models and implemented infrastructure for a brand-new approach to identifying user-uploaded VR video content using video content embeddings, user graph embeddings, and video metadata.
Implemented a trending user videos module serving ~50k users/day on the FB mobile Oculus hub on iOS and Android.

positions.title: Laboratory Research Assistant
positions.description:
Helped develop C++ software to control the mirror alignment system of a first-of-its-kind prototype gamma-ray telescope, the prototype Schwarzschild-Couder Telescope. Was used to align 72 mirror panels to sub-millimeter precision using 432 actuators and data from over 300 laser edge sensors. Successful preliminary alignment was achieved in spring/summer 2019 and the telescope was used to collect first-light data.
Advisor: Prof. Vladimir Vassiliev

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked with the Columbia high-energy astrophysics group on using deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to analyze gamma-ray telescope data and published some of the earliest results in this area  [https://arxiv.org/abs/1709.05889]. 
Created and contributed significantly to CTLearn, an open-source Python package for analysis of ground-based gamma-ray telescope data with neural networks. Currently being used and developed by researchers from several institutions in the U.S. and Europe [https://github.com/ctlearn-project/ctlearn].

Advisor: Prof. Brian Humensky
